generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table, never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample uniformly from the parent table's final key pool (union of compact original keys and generated keys); allow NULL only if the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_id: Zero-padded numeric strings of length 3-6, unique per table, never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_text: Random words from a small pool of 20-40 tokens, length 3-30, with 5% near-duplicate variants (case/whitespace changes) of an existing value.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_address_line: Random street number + name + suffix, optional Apt/Suite.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_city: Random city-like tokens; 20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT columns.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_state: One of 20 US state names; 20-50% duplicate share.
generic_sampling_rules.decimal_price: Uniform in [0, 100000000] with 4 decimal places; 5% boundary values at 0, 100, 1000000, 1000001.
generic_sampling_rules.datetime: Random datetime between 1970-01-01 and 2020-12-31, format %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S; 20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT columns.
generic_sampling_rules.char_code: Short uppercase code of length 2-15 from a fixed enum pool.
generic_sampling_rules.char_status: One of a small enum pool (2-4 values).
generic_sampling_rules.nullable_text: NULL with probability min(observed_null_rate, 0.95); otherwise a random text value; every nullable column gets at least one NULL row and at least one non-NULL row per instance.
generic_sampling_rules.quantity_varchar: One of '1','2','3','4','5','6' as strings; 20-50% duplicate share.

uncertainty.group_sizes_relaxation: Invoices.payment_method_code group_sizes relaxed to '1 and >= 2' because Ref_Payment_Methods has only 3 rows and payment_method_code is an enum of 3 values; a 1,2,>=3 distribution across 3 distinct values is impossible.
uncertainty.services_price_boundary: Services.Product_Price >= 0 rule relaxed to >= -39.0001 to allow the comparison_boundary target values -39.0001, -39, -38.9999 to survive generation; all six boundary values must be present after null injection and clamping.
uncertainty.aggregate_boundary: Products.Product_Price must keep a broad distribution while its per-instance AVG lands in [999999, 1000002]; adjust a small number of values to hit the target sum rather than collapsing all values to the midpoint.
uncertainty.enum_group_sizes: Enum columns carrying a group_sizes exception (Services.Service_Type_Code, Drama_Workshop_Groups.Marketing_Region_Code) must be routed through the group-size allocator so the 1/2/>=3 distribution is realized.
uncertainty.fk_pool_union: The parent key pool for every FK must be the union of compact original keys and generated keys, because the writer appends to a copy of the compact database; drawing only from generated keys produces FK violations against compact rows.
uncertainty.composite_fk: Invoice_Items.(Order_ID,Product_ID) must be assigned from a single Bookings_Services parent tuple; assigning each column independently from a single-column list breaks the composite FK.
uncertainty.nullable_fk_null_rate: For nullable FK columns (Invoices.payment_method_code) and nullable enum columns (Services.Service_Type_Code), compute the NULL share from the child column's own compact share, not the parent's, and guarantee at least one NULL and one non-NULL row per instance.
uncertainty.post_generation_checks: After generation, assert per instance: AVG(Products.Product_Price) in [999999, 1000002]; all six Services.Product_Price boundary values present; at least one Ref_Payment_Methods row without Invoices children and at least one Invoices row with NULL payment_method_code; composite FK Invoice_Items.(Order_ID,Product_ID) matches a Bookings_Services tuple; no FK violations against the final written database.
